challengeTypes: identify: Which of these is a deficiency disease caused by lack of Vitamin C? (Scurvy vs Diabetes vs Obesity vs Heart disease)
sort: Drag each food to healthy or junk food (Fresh fruits = Healthy | Vegetables = Healthy | Burger = Junk | Chips = Junk | Soda = Junk | Whole grains = Healthy | Milk = Healthy | Fried food = Junk)
identify: What disease is caused by deficiency of iron in the diet? (Anaemia vs Rickets vs Goitre vs Night blindness)

sort: Drag each deficiency disease to its missing nutrient (Scurvy = Vitamin C | Rickets = Vitamin D and Calcium | Night blindness = Vitamin A | Goitre = Iodine | Anaemia = Iron | Beri-beri = Vitamin B1)
identify: Which of these is a lifestyle disease? (Diabetes vs Cold vs Scurvy vs Broken bone)

sort: Drag each lifestyle disease to its main cause (Diabetes = too much sugar, lack of exercise | Heart disease = fatty diet, no exercise | Obesity = overeating, no physical activity | High blood pressure = stress, salty food | Type 2 diabetes = poor diet and sedentary lifestyle | Tooth decay = too many sweets, poor brushing)
identify: What should you do to prevent lifestyle diseases? (Eat balanced diet and exercise regularly vs Eat more junk food vs Skip breakfast daily vs Watch TV all day)

sort: Drag each health tip to its correct category (Prevent deficiency = eat varied diet with vitamins and minerals | Prevent lifestyle disease = exercise daily, eat less junk food | Build strong bones = drink milk, eat calcium-rich food | Boost immunity = eat fruits, vegetables, sleep well | Avoid junk food = limit burgers, chips, soda | Stay hydrated = drink 8 glasses of water daily)
extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Junk food and its effects — junk food is high in sugar, salt, and fat but low in nutrients. Examples: burgers, chips, soda, candy, fried food. Effects: obesity, tooth decay, low energy, poor concentration, heart problems later in life. Healthy food gives nutrients: fruits, vegetables, whole grains, milk, eggs, pulses. (2) Deficiency diseases — caused by lack of specific nutrients. Scurvy = lack of Vitamin C (bleeding gums, found in citrus fruits). Rickets = lack of Vitamin D and Calcium (weak bones, found in sunlight and milk). Night blindness = lack of Vitamin A (poor vision at night, found in carrots, green vegetables). Goitre = lack of Iodine (swollen neck, found in iodized salt). Anaemia = lack of Iron (tiredness, pale skin, found in green leafy vegetables, jaggery). Beri-beri = lack of Vitamin B1 (weakness, found in whole grains). (3) Lifestyle diseases — caused by poor lifestyle choices, not by germs. Diabetes = too much sugar and lack of exercise. Heart disease = fatty diet and no exercise. Obesity = overeating and no physical activity. High blood pressure = stress and too much salt. Tooth decay = too many sweets and poor brushing. Prevention: balanced diet, regular exercise, 8 hours sleep, drink water, limit junk food. Misconceptions: 'junk food gives energy' (WRONG — junk food gives a quick sugar rush but causes energy crash; healthy food gives sustained energy), 'deficiency diseases are contagious' (WRONG — deficiency diseases are caused by lack of nutrients, not by germs; they cannot spread from person to person), 'only old people get lifestyle diseases' (WRONG — lifestyle diseases are increasingly affecting children due to poor diet and lack of exercise), 'eating more food means better nutrition' (WRONG — quantity does not equal quality; junk food has calories but lacks nutrients), 'vitamins are only found in pills' (WRONG — vitamins are naturally found in fruits, vegetables, milk, eggs, and whole grains).
